## How to Open the Mysterious Bunker in GTA 6

As the gaming community eagerly awaits more details on Rockstar Games' upcoming title, new information has emerged regarding some of the intricate investigative gameplay hidden within the massive open world. According to a recent report by gaming outlet GameRant, players will have the opportunity to dive into a compelling mystery involving the assassination of President Russo.

Solving this major in-game puzzle requires more than just standard action-oriented gameplay. Players must use their investigative skills to uncover hidden secrets scattered across the map.

### Locating the Bunkers and Finding Codes

To crack the case of President Russo's assassination, players must locate two specific bunkers hidden within the game's environment. 

* **Find the Two Bunkers:** Exploration is key. Players will need to scour the terrain to find the exact entry points of these secretive underground facilities.
* **Acquire the Codes:** Simply finding the door won't get you inside. Access codes must be secured to unlock the bunkers and proceed with the investigation.

### Rewards Awaiting Players

Successfully navigating these high-security areas and bringing the mystery to a close will grant players special rewards. While the exact payout or items remain part of the discovery process, these narrative-driven secrets add an extra layer of depth to the overall experience.

### Editor's Take

This newly highlighted mystery showcases how Rockstar plans to enrich the open-world experience with detailed, multi-step investigative tasks. Hunting down bunkers and cracking codes will definitely appeal to players who love deep-dive exploration and narrative secrets in GTA 6.

*(Note: This information is based on reporting from GameRant and highlights gameplay elements intended for the full release.)*
